authority.why_this_source: The board's own complete document for 4ET1 — it carries both papers, every question's AO allocation and every section total, and it extracts cleanly. The per-text mark schemes on disk (Modern Drama June 2023, Modern Prose June 2024, Shakespeare June 2024) are single-topic extracts; this is the whole specification of the assessment.
authority.extraction_note: ⚠️ A NOTE ON EVIDENCE, worth keeping. The first cut of this file recorded the quotes as 'AO2 (20 mark )' and 'Un een Poetry' and explained it as a font-mapping quirk in the PDF. That was wrong: the corruption came from MY OWN pipeline — BSD sed does not support \s, so `sed -E 's/\s+/ /g'` was deleting every letter 's' from the output I was reading. The PDF extracts perfectly. Root CLAUDE.md §19: the instrument is part of the measurement, and a mangled reading looks exactly like a mangled source.
